purpose: Phase 1 envelope sanity test of bielik-11b-v30 (BF16, TP=1) on dual-R9700 / vLLM 0.19.0+rocm721 stack via OpenAI-compatible vllm serve endpoint.

config.port_note: Port 8100 used because :8000 was occupied by long-running ai-dashboard (pid 2554, started ~08:51 prior); see issues section.

load_time_breakdown.method: wall-clock from vllm-banner timestamp 21:53:58 to 'Application startup complete' 21:54:25; corroborated by curl-poll on /v1/models

vram_per_gpu_note: rocm-smi --showmeminfo vram --csv sampled after model load with request idle. card0 = primary (TP=1), card1 = essentially empty as expected. card2 (iGPU RAPHAEL) excluded per ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES.
kv_cache_gb_note: vLLM 0.19 introspection path does not expose gpu_cache_size_bytes directly; available_gb (7.17) is from worker init log, not from cache geometry. Same gap as 4.5B record — to be patched in v0.3 sanity runner.
max_concurrency_note: 'Maximum concurrency for 8192 tokens per request' from vLLM kv_cache_utils. Compare to 4.5B which reported 5.65x.

test_response_time_note: End-to-end curl POST → JSON response, includes HTTP roundtrip + tokenization. Truncated at max_tokens=128 (finish_reason=length).
throughput_note: Engine-side averages from vllm loggers.py at 21:54:45 (single-prompt window). NOT a scaling claim — Phase 1 baseline only, per METHODOLOGY §5.1 and §11.1.
issues_encountered: Initial launch attempted '--disable-log-requests' flag (per task spec); vllm 0.19 has removed/renamed this flag: 'vllm: error: unrecognized arguments: --disable-log-requests'. Retry without the flag succeeded.

Port :8000 was occupied by user's long-running ai-dashboard server (python3 /home/mozarcik/ai-dashboard/.venv/bin/python3 server.py, pid 2554, ~9h uptime). Test was relocated to port :8100; not killed.
kill_method: SIGTERM to recorded PID from /tmp/bielik-11b-v30.pid; clean exit in 2 s (no SIGKILL needed, no pkill used).
